label: Disclosed mandatory fee
definition: A required charge identified before commitment or payment.

label: Poorly disclosed mandatory fee
definition: A required charge whose timing label amount or condition is difficult to understand.

label: Optional add-on
definition: A charge for an optional product or service.

label: Automatically selected add-on
definition: An optional charge selected by default.

label: Recurring fee
definition: A charge that repeats while an account or service remains active.
limitations: Account history and renewal terms are necessary.

label: Contract-triggered fee
definition: A charge activated by cancellation renewal late payment or another contract event.

label: Duplicate or unclear charge
definition: A repeated bundled or insufficiently described line item.
limitations: Complete records and human confirmation are required.
